versions.changelog: Release v2.0.0: safer public-page GMC misrepresentation audit workflow with evidence-based findings.

- Added baseline Google Merchant Center policy reference and audit scripts for store and product pages.
- Introduced agent and metadata YAML configuration files.
- Updated skill manifest with versioning, author, license, platform, and additional metadata.
- No changes to core audit workflow, rules, or reporting—documentation enhancements and code modularization only.

- Simplified and clarified documentation in SKILL.md for easier onboarding and use.
- Updated hard rules: clarified upgrade behavior, reinforced read-only and sandboxing requirements, and emphasized parsing all JSON-LD blocks.
- Streamlined audit workflow instructions, script entry points, and reporting requirements.
- Updated trigger scenarios and onboarding guidance.
- Removed duplicate or redundant files: openai.yaml and skill-card.md.

Initial release: two-phase GMC Misrepresentation audit (store-level + product-level), no API token required, policy discovery with /pages/ support, HTML report with disclaimer and official GMC reference docs.
